idea: Routines & independence #4 – I can help SET THE TABLE (Thanksgiving Day dinner-time routine; LIVING ROOM, Ava in HOME outfit standing behind the low round light-wood coffee table): hook 'Oh no! Empty table! Dinner time!' – Ava gasps holding up a plain PINK PLATE beside her face over the empty table; 'A pink plate! Plate, plate, plate!' + copy-me 'On the table! Pat, pat, pat!' (she puts it down and pats the table); 'A blue cup! Cup, cup, cup!' + copy-me 'Clap with me! Clap, clap, clap!'; 'A yellow spoon! Spoon, spoon, spoon!'; spoon, plate and cup in a neat row – 'What do we need? Hmm?' (2 s humming pause) – 'Plate, cup, spoon! Yay!'; lesson 'I can help! I set the table!'. Loop: the hook framing again with the table set, bye-bye wave.
lesson: Helping at home / independence: a toddler can set the table for dinner – plate, cup, spoon.
